DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: メッセージの件で相談に来られたのですね。今、誰かが近くに来ている状況ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You came to ask about a message. Is someone nearby at present?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今のところ来ていません。でも、帰り道で待っているという連絡が届いて、怖くてここへ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相手は来ていないが帰り道で待つという連絡が怖くて来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not so far. But I received a message saying they are waiting on my way home, and I was frightened, so I came here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say nobody has come yet, but a message about waiting on your route home frightened you into coming here. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まずメッセージを確認しましょう。誰から届いたか、心当たりはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us first check the message. Do you have any idea who sent it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昔の知り合いかもしれませんが、知らないアカウントなので確かではありません。名前だけを見て決め付けたくないです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 知人かもしれないが知らないアカウントで送信者は確かでないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It might be an old acquaintance, but it is an unfamiliar account, so I am not certain. I do not want to decide just from the name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it might be an acquaintance but the account is unfamiliar and the sender is uncertain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。その点は未確認として伺います。届いた時刻と、画面にある文章を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. We will treat that as unconfirmed. Please show the receipt time and text on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 午後四時十二分に届きました。消す前に画面を保存しましたが、アプリの中にも元のメッセージが残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受信時刻、保存した画面、アプリ内に残る元のメッセージを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It arrived at 4:12 p.m. I saved the screen before deleting anything, and the original message remains in the app too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the receipt time, saved screen and original message remaining in the app. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 元のメッセージも消さずに残してください。住所や帰り道を、相手へ返事で教えたりはしていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep the original message without deleting it too. Have you replied with your address or route home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返事はしていません。怖いのでアカウントを削除したかったのですが、先に保存して相談しようと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返信せず、削除より先に保存して相談したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not replied. I was scared and wanted to delete the account, but decided to save things and seek advice first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you did not reply and saved the information to seek advice before deleting anything. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今の経緯を記録します。帰りの安全についても、この後一緒に考えましょう。一人で相手に会いに行かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record what happened. We will also think together about getting home safely. Do not go to meet the person alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は一人で帰るのが不安です。元の連絡を残したまま、迎えを頼める家族へここから電話してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一人の帰宅が不安で、原文を残して家族に迎えを頼む電話をしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I am worried about going home alone today. May I call my family from here to ask for a lift while keeping the original message?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that going home alone worries you and you want to keep the original message while calling family to collect you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ええ、ここでご家族に連絡してください。お帰りになる前にもう一度お声掛けくださいね。では、いったん失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please contact your family here. Speak to me again before leaving. I will leave you for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送のご相談でしょうか。箱はまだ閉じていないようですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about sending something? The box is not closed yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分で作った湯飲みを二つ送ります。中を見てから閉じようと思って、テープはまだ貼っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自作の湯飲み二つを送り、点検前なので箱にテープを貼っていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending two teacups I made. I wanted the inside checked before closing it, so I have not taped it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are sending two handmade teacups and have not taped the box because it has not been inspected. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 拝見します。二つの湯飲みが直接触れていますね。このままでは、輸送中にぶつかるおそれがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me look. The two cups are touching directly. They could knock against each other in transit like this.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それぞれ紙で包んだつもりでしたが、薄すぎたんですね。間に詰める物を足せばいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 薄い紙の包装を認識し、器の間へ詰め物を足す方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I had wrapped each in paper, but it was too thin. Should I add packing material between them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Recognize the thin paper wrapping and ask about adding material between the cups. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一つずつ十分に保護して、器同士や箱に直接当たらないようにしてください。箱の中で動かないことも大事です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Protect each cup sufficiently so they do not directly hit each other or the box. It is also important that they cannot move inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は詰め物を持っていないので、家で包み直します。宛名の紙は、この箱から外して取っておいてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家で包み直すと決め、発送前の宛名紙を外して保存できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have no packing material today, so I will rewrap them at home. May I remove the address paper from this box and keep it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to rewrap at home and ask whether you may remove and keep the address note before dispatch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ発送手続き前ですし、その紙はお客様の宛名メモなので大丈夫です。戻ってくる時は、送り先と差出人が読めるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The shipping procedure has not started, and it is your own address note, so that is fine. When returning, make sure the recipient and sender are readable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 紙を取っておきます。割れ物と書けば、包装が少し緩くても特別に守ってもらえるわけではないですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 割れ物の表示が緩い包装を補うわけではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will keep the paper. Writing fragile does not mean loose wrapping will receive special protection, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that a fragile label does not compensate for loose packaging. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、表示だけで包装を補うことはできません。包み直した箱で、重さや大きさ、利用できる送り方を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct, a label alone cannot make up for packaging. With the repacked box, let us check weight, size and available shipping methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。器を別々に保護して、箱の中で動かないようにしてから、宛名メモと一緒に持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 器を別々に保護して箱内で動かないようにし、宛名メモと再持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will protect the cups separately and stop them moving inside the box, then bring it back with the address note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will protect the cups separately, prevent movement in the box and bring it back with the address note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待ちしています。湯飲みはそのまま箱に戻しますね。では、お気を付けてお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will wait for you. I will return the cups to the box as they are. Please take care carrying them home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の確認ですね。まだ実行ボタンは押していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to confirm a bank transfer. Have you not pressed the execute button yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。修理代の請求書には青葉設備株式会社とありますが、画面にはカ）アオバセツビと出ていて心配になりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未実行であると伝え、請求書の会社名と画面の短縮名義の違いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. The repair invoice says Aoba Equipment Co., Ltd., but the screen shows KA) AOBA SETSUBI, so I became worried.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the transfer is not executed and point out the company name on the invoice differs from the abbreviated screen name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: カタカナの表記で、株式会社が短く表示されることはあります。ただ、名前だけで振込先が正しいと決めず、番号なども照合しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: In katakana notation, the corporate designation can be abbreviated. But do not decide the destination is correct from the name alone; compare the account number and other details too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 請求書を持ってきました。銀行名と支店名は同じですが、口座番号は一桁ずつ一緒に見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 請求書の銀行名と支店名は一致すると伝え、番号を一桁ずつ確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I brought the invoice. The bank and branch names match, but could you check the account number digit by digit with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the invoice's bank and branch match and ask for the number to be checked digit by digit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、この請求書の番号と入力した番号は一致しています。名義も対応する表記です。次に金額を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, this invoice number matches the entered number. The account name is a corresponding notation too. Please check the amount next.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 請求額は一万八千円で、画面も一万八千円です。下にある三百円は相手に送る金額へ追加されるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 請求額と画面の一万八千円を照合し、三百円が送金額へ足されるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The invoice is 18,000 yen, and the screen also says 18,000 yen. Is the 300 yen below added to what the recipient receives?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Match the invoice and screen amounts of 18,000 yen and ask whether 300 yen is added to the remitted amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この画面では三百円は手数料です。受取人への振込額は一万八千円、口座から出る合計は一万八千三百円になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: On this screen, 300 yen is the fee. The recipient receives 18,000 yen, and the total taken from the account is 18,300 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手には請求額だけ届くんですね。振込が終わったことを修理業者へ知らせたいので、控えを保存する方法も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手に届く金額を理解し、業者へ知らせるため控えの保存方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: So the recipient receives only the invoiced amount. I want to tell the repair company once the transfer is done; please also show me how to save the record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Understand what the recipient receives and ask how to save a record for notifying the company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 完了後に出る取引番号を控えてください。画面の保存方法もご案内します。ただ、完了画面と、相手が入金を確認したことは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Note the transaction number shown after completion. We will also explain saving the screen. But a completion screen and the recipient confirming receipt are different.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 取引番号と完了画面を残します。業者には振込手続きをしたと伝え、入金の確認は先方にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 取引番号と画面を保存し、手続きの連絡と先方の入金確認を分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the transaction number and completion screen. I will tell the company I carried out the transfer procedure and ask them to confirm receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will save the number and screen and distinguish notifying the procedure from the recipient's confirmation of funds. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。実行前に、もう一度画面全体をご確認ください。私は隣の窓口におります。では、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Before executing, check the whole screen once more. I will be at the next counter. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計ですね。お持ちの袋にお入れになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ready to pay? Will you put these in your own bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: そうしようと思ったのですが、底が破れていました。牛乳を入れると落ちそうなので、袋を二枚お願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参袋の底が破れて牛乳が落ちそうなので、袋を二枚求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I intended to, but its bottom is torn. Milk might fall through, so I would like two bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the bottom of your bag is torn and milk could fall out, and request two bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二枚ですね。この袋は一枚五円です。牛乳と冷凍食品、卵を分けて入れましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Two bags. These cost five yen each. Shall we separate the milk and frozen food from the eggs?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、牛乳と冷凍食品を一枚に、卵をもう一枚にお願いします。卵の上には重い物を置かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 牛乳と冷凍食品を一袋、卵を別袋にし、卵の上へ重い物を置かないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, milk and frozen food in one bag, eggs in the other please. Do not put heavy things on the eggs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request milk and frozen food in one bag, eggs in another, and no heavy items on top of the eggs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。袋代十円を含めて、二千六百四十円になります。お支払いはどうなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Certainly. Including ten yen for bags, that is 2,640 yen. How would you like to pay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: スマートフォンで払うつもりでしたが、電池が切れています。このレジで現金に変えても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: スマートフォンの電池切れを説明し、現金払いへ変えられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I intended to use my smartphone, but its battery is flat. Can I switch to cash at this till?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the phone battery is flat and ask to switch to cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだお支払い前なので大丈夫です。現金で二千六百四十円をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You have not paid yet, so that is fine. Please pay 2,640 yen in cash.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では三千円を出します。破れた自分の袋は、買った袋と一緒に持ち帰るので捨てなくて結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三千円を渡し、破れた持参袋も持ち帰るので捨てなくてよいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here is 3,000 yen. I will take my torn bag home with the purchased bags, so you do not need to throw it away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hand over 3,000 yen and say the torn bag will be taken home too and need not be discarded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 三千円お預かりして、お釣りは三百六十円です。レシートはこちらです。冷凍食品の入った袋は重いので、持ち手を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Received 3,000 yen; your change is 360 yen. Here is the receipt. The bag with frozen food is heavy, so check the handles.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三百六十円を受け取りました。牛乳の袋の持ち手を確かめてから、卵の袋と分けて運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三百六十円を受け取り、牛乳の袋の持ち手を確認し、卵とは分けて運ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I received 360 yen. I will check the milk bag's handles, then carry it separately from the egg bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you received 360 yen and will check the milk bag's handles and carry it separately from the eggs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、二つともお渡しします。お忘れ物のないように。ありがとうございました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then here are both bags. Please do not forget anything. Thank you, and come again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内を歩かれますか。この案内図で道を確認できますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you walk in the park? You can check the paths on this map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少し歩きたいのですが、今日は疲れやすくて、坂を上る自信がありません。途中で戻りやすい道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今日は疲れやすく坂に自信がないと説明し、途中で戻りやすい道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want a short walk, but I tire easily today and am not confident about climbing slopes. Is there a path where it is easy to turn back partway?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you tire easily and are unsure about slopes today, and ask for a path with an easy return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この入口から東のベンチまでなら、平らな道で行けます。奥の丘へ行く道には進まなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: From this entrance to the eastern bench, you can take a flat path. You do not have to continue towards the hill farther in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 東のベンチまでにします。図の点線は近道ですか。帰りにそこを通ると楽になるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 東のベンチまでと決め、図の点線が楽な近道か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will go only to the eastern bench. Is the dotted line a shortcut? Would taking it back be easier?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the eastern bench and ask whether the dotted line is an easy shortcut. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 点線は階段のある道です。距離は短いですが、今日は来た平らな道を戻る方がよさそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The dotted line has stairs. It is shorter, but today returning along the flat path you came on seems better.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 階段は避けて同じ道を戻ります。ベンチまで行く途中にも、座れる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 階段を避け同じ道を戻ると決め、途中にも座れる場所があるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will avoid stairs and return the same way. Is there somewhere to sit before reaching the bench too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to avoid stairs and return the same way, and ask about seats along the route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 途中の木陰に一つあります。ただ、空いているとは限らないので、無理にベンチまで進む必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is one in the shade partway. But it may be occupied, so you do not need to force yourself to continue to the bench.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 途中の席が空いていなければ、休める所を探して先へ進むより、入口へ戻ります。入口の休憩所も使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 先へ無理に進まず入口へ戻ると伝え、入口の休憩所を使えるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If that seat is occupied, I will return to the entrance rather than go farther searching for somewhere to rest. Can I use the entrance rest area too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not push onward but return to the entrance, and ask to use its rest area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、入口の休憩所を使えます。戻る時はこの分かれ道で売店側へ入らず、入口の表示を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, you can. When returning, do not turn towards the shop at this fork; look for the entrance sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 東へ短く歩いて、疲れたら引き返します。帰りは入口の表示をたどり、休憩所で休んでから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 短く東へ歩き、疲れたら入口表示に沿って戻り、休憩後に帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will walk a short way east and turn back if tired. On the way back I will follow entrance signs, rest at the rest area and then leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will walk briefly east, follow entrance signs back if tired, rest and then go home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その日の調子に合わせてくださいね。では、足元に気を付けていってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please match your plans to how you feel that day. Watch your footing and enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 放送の後で案内板を見ていらっしゃいましたね。聞き取れなかったところがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were looking at the information board after the announcement. Was there a part you could not catch?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 『点検のため』までは聞こえましたが、その後が分かりませんでした。次の列車は遅れているのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 点検の後の放送が聞こえなかったと説明し次の列車が遅れているか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard up to because of an inspection, but not what followed. Is the next train delayed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you could not hear the announcement after inspection and ask whether the next train is delayed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、車両点検で発車を見合わせています。再開時刻はまだ決まっていません。どちらまで行かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, departures are suspended for a rolling-stock inspection. A restart time has not yet been decided. Where are you going?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 佐賀方面です。会社には九時に着くと言ってしまったので、何分遅れるかだけでも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 佐賀方面へ行くことと会社に九時到着と伝えたことを説明し遅れを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Towards Saga. I already told work I would arrive at nine, so I at least want to know how many minutes late it will be.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the Saga direction and that you told work nine o'clock arrival, and ask the delay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現時点で到着の遅れはお約束できません。会社へは再開待ちとお伝えいただくのがよいと思います。しばらく駅で待たれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot promise the arrival delay at present. I suggest telling work you are waiting for service to resume. Will you wait at the station for a while?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 待ちます。ただ、ホームの表示だけを見ていると連絡しにくいので、改札の近くへ戻ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駅で待つと決め連絡しやすい改札近くへ戻れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will wait. But it is hard to contact them while only watching the platform display; may I return near the gates?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to wait at the station and ask to return near the gates where contacting work is easier. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 改札を出ずに、内側の待合スペースで待てます。そこでも案内板と放送を確認できます。改札の外へ出る場合は先にご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can wait in the waiting area inside without exiting the gates. You can check the board and announcements there too. Ask us first if you wish to go outside the gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 内側で待ちます。聞き取れない放送がまた流れたら、この窓口で内容を聞いてもいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 改札内で待つと伝え今後の放送も窓口で聞き直せるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait inside. If another announcement is unclear, may I ask its content again at this counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will wait inside the gates and confirm you may ask about future announcements at the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、聞き直していただいて構いません。案内板には再開の見込みが分かった段階で情報が出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please ask again. Information will appear on the board once a restart estimate is known.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社には点検で再開待ちだと連絡し、到着時刻はまだ伝えません。まず内側の待合スペースへ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 勤務先へ再開待ちと連絡し未定の到着時刻は伝えず改札内の待合へ行くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell work the inspection means I am waiting for service to resume, without giving an arrival time yet. First I will go to the waiting area inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell work you are waiting for service to resume, give no undecided arrival time and go to the waiting area inside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご案内が変わったら表示もご確認ください。気をつけて待合スペースへお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the display if the guidance changes. Take care returning to the waiting area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談の受付をご希望ですか。ご本人がお越しになっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to register for consultation? Is the person concerned here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 相談したいのは同居人です。外で待っていますが、日本語が不安なので私も一緒に話を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同居人が外で待っており日本語が不安なので同席したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My housemate wants advice. They are waiting outside, but are worried about Japanese, so I want to listen with them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your housemate waits outside and you want to attend because Japanese worries them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何についてのご相談でしょうか。ご本人が同席を希望されているかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: What is the consultation about? We also want to confirm the person wants you present.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家に届いた案内の内容です。本人から一緒に聞いてほしいと頼まれていますが、手続きを代わりにするつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家に届いた案内の相談で本人が同席を希望し代理手続きではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Information that arrived at home. They asked me to listen with them, but I do not intend to handle the procedure in their place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain it concerns home-delivered information, the person wants you present and this is not proxy processing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内の発行元が分かると担当を確認できます。案内そのものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Knowing the issuer will help identify the responsible section. Have you brought the information itself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人が封筒ごと持っています。呼んできますので、本人から用件を話してもらってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人が封筒を持っていると伝え本人を呼び直接説明してもらってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: They have it with the envelope. May I call them over and have them explain directly?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the person has the envelope and ask to bring them over to explain directly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、その方が確認しやすいです。担当を確認してから相談予約が必要かご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, that makes checking easier. After identifying the section, we will explain whether a consultation booking is necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本人も来ました。内容を説明した後で、予約が必要なら今日ここで日時を決められますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人が来たと知らせ相談内容の説明後に必要な予約日時をその場で決められるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: They are here now. After explaining the matter, if booking is necessary, can we set a date and time here today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the person has arrived and ask whether the necessary appointment can be set there after explaining the matter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まず担当の空き状況を調べます。今日は希望を伺うだけになる可能性もありますので、連絡先はご本人のものをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: First we will check availability. Today we may only be able to take preferences, so please give the person's own contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人の電話番号を使います。私は説明を聞く補助として同席し、希望の日時は本人から伝えてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の連絡先を使い自分は説明補助にとどめ希望日時は本人から伝えると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will use their phone number. I will only attend to help understand explanations, and they will state their preferred date and time themselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm use of the person's contact, your limited support role and that they will state their preferred time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お二人の役割が分かりました。それでは案内を持って、こちらの相談受付へどうぞ。ご相談が進むよう担当におつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I understand your roles. Then bring the information to this consultation reception. We will connect you to the staff so the consultation can proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察は終わりましたね。お帰りになる前に、何か確認したいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your examination is finished. Is there anything to check before leaving?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社が休暇の確認に紙を出してほしいと言っています。今日の領収書に、休む日数を書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社の休暇確認に必要な紙として領収書へ休む日数を書けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Work wants a paper to confirm leave. Could you write the number of days off on today's receipt?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to write leave days on the receipt as paperwork needed for work's leave confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 領収書は支払った内容を示す書類です。休む期間については医師の確認が必要です。会社から書式などを渡されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: A receipt shows what was paid for. The leave period needs a doctor's confirmation. Has work given you a form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この用紙をもらいました。『受診日』と『勤務できない期間』の二つの欄があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社の用紙に受診日と勤務できない期間の二欄があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I received this sheet. It has two fields: consultation date and period unable to work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the workplace form has fields for consultation date and period unable to work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つの欄は内容が違いますね。書類の受付や費用は窓口で確認できます。医師への確認も必要なので、私から受付にお伝えしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Those fields concern different matters. The counter can confirm document requests and fees. A doctor's confirmation is needed too; shall I tell reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。実は会社が、今日は受診日だけ分かればよいと言っていたかもしれません。電話で確認してから頼みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付への連絡を頼み会社が受診日だけを求めている可能性を説明し確認してから申込むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Actually, work may have said only the consultation date is needed today. I want to call to confirm before requesting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for reception to be informed, explain work may need only the date and say you will confirm before applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、今は書類の発行を申し込まずに、会社へ必要な欄を確認しましょう。用紙は一度お返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then do not request issuance yet; ask work which fields are needed. I will return the form for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 用紙を受け取りました。もし受診日だけでよいなら、領収書で足りるかも会社に聞いてみます。会計は先に済ませられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 用紙を受け取ったと伝え領収書で足りるか会社に聞く方針と先に会計できるかを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have received the form. If just the date is enough, I will also ask work whether the receipt is sufficient. Can I settle payment first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the returned form, say you will ask whether the receipt suffices and ask to pay first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会計については受付に確認してください。書類は申し込み内容が決まってから相談したいということも、私から伝えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ask reception about payment. I will also tell them you want to discuss documents once your request is decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では会計の窓口へ行きます。会社には必要な欄と領収書でよいかを確認し、医師の記載が必要なら改めて書類を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会計へ進み会社へ必要欄と領収書の可否を聞き医師記載が必要なら書類相談する順序を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will go to the payment counter. I will ask work about the fields and whether a receipt is enough, and discuss documents again if a doctor's writing is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe going to pay, asking work about fields and receipt acceptance, then consulting documents if doctor entries are needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順番で受付へおつなぎします。会社の用紙もお忘れなく。どうぞお大事にしてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you to reception in that order. Do not forget the workplace form. Take care and get well soon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 練習会の後に、持ち帰った荷物が足りないと気づかれたのですね。なくなった物を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: After rehearsal, you noticed you had not brought all your belongings home. Please describe what is missing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: フルートが入った細長いケースです。昨日、練習会から帰った後、家に持ち帰っていないことに気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: フルート入りの細長いケースを練習会から持ち帰っていないと気づいた状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A long narrow case containing a flute. Yesterday after returning from rehearsal, I realized I had not brought it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe noticing after rehearsal that you had not brought home the long narrow flute case. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会場を出る前にはありましたか。最後に見た場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you have it before leaving the venue? Where did you last see it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会場の玄関で椅子に置いたのは覚えています。ただ、同じような黒いケースが三つ並んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会場玄関の椅子に置いた記憶と似た黒いケースが三つあったことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I remember putting it on a chair in the venue entrance. But there were three similar black cases lined up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain remembering placing it on a chair at the entrance and three similar black cases. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 取り違えの可能性もありますね。ご自分のケースだけにある目印は何かありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: It could have been mixed up. Is there a mark unique to your case?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 取っ手の内側に、赤い糸を巻いています。名前は外には書いていませんが、中の布に私の名字があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 取っ手の内側の赤い糸と内部の布の名字という固有の目印を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I wrapped red thread around the inside of the handle. My name is not outside, but my surname is on the cloth inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the unique red thread inside the handle and surname on the inner cloth. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取っ手の赤い糸と、中の布の名字ですね。会場や練習会の主催者には、すでに確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Red thread on the handle and surname on the inner cloth. Have you already checked with the venue or rehearsal organizer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 主催者には連絡しました。残っていたケースはないそうで、参加者にも確認してもらっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 主催者に確認し残ったケースはなく参加者へ照会中と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I contacted the organizer. They said no case was left, and are checking with participants too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the organizer was contacted, no case remained and participants are being asked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その確認状況も記録します。こちらに届いた物については特徴を照合しますので、連絡の取れる電話番号を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record those checks too. We will match features of anything handed in here; please give a reachable phone number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この番号です。仕事中は出られないことがあるので、不在着信があったら折り返します。布の名字もここに書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡番号を示し仕事中の不在着信には折り返すと伝え名字を記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: This number. I sometimes cannot answer at work, so I will return missed calls. I will write the surname on the cloth here too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the number, say you will return missed calls during work and write the surname. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 届け出を受け付けました。見つかった場合や新しい情報があればお知らせください。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your report is accepted. Please tell us if it is found or there is new information. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票を二枚お持ちですね。お受け取りについてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have two missed-delivery notices. Would you like advice about collection?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の票と今日の票です。荷物を二つ頼んだ覚えがないのですが、両方とも受け取りの予約が要りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日と今日の不在票があるが二つ頼んだ覚えはなく両方の受取予約が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: One from yesterday and one from today. I do not remember ordering two parcels; do I need a collection booking for both?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have yesterday's and today's notices but do not remember two orders, and ask if both need collection bookings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二枚の荷物番号を比べましょう。こちらでお預かりして確認してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us compare the parcel numbers. May I take the two notices to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。昨日の分は、すでに明日の再配達を申し込んでいます。今日の分はまだ何もしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二枚の確認を頼み昨日の票で明日の再配達を申込み今日の票は未対応と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please. I already requested redelivery tomorrow for yesterday's one. I have done nothing with today's yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to check both and say yesterday's notice has tomorrow's redelivery booked while today's is unhandled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号は同じで、同じ荷物への配達のお知らせですね。明日の再配達希望も一件確認できました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The numbers match; both notify delivery of the same parcel. I can also confirm one redelivery request for tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一つだけなのですね。でも明日は急な残業になりました。二枚目の票から別の日時を入れ直せばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同じ荷物と理解し明日の残業のため二枚目から日時を入れ直すべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only one, then. But I suddenly have overtime tomorrow. Should I enter another date from the second notice?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Understand it is the same parcel and ask about changing the date through the second notice because of overtime. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別々に申し込む前に、今ある希望の変更を確認しましょう。窓口受け取りも考えていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before applying separately, let us check changing the existing request. Are you considering counter collection too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: できれば窓口で受け取りたいです。今ここに荷物があるなら今日持ち帰れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 窓口受け取りを希望し今荷物があれば今日持ち帰れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: If possible, I want counter collection. If the parcel is here now, could I take it home today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request counter collection and ask to take it today if it is there now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在は配達担当が持ち出していて、この窓口ではお渡しできません。戻りを確認してから、受取場所と方法の変更をご相談いただく必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The delivery staff currently have it out, so this counter cannot hand it over. After confirming its return, you need to discuss changes to collection place and method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では今日の受け取りはできないと分かりました。二重に申し込まず、戻ったことを確認してから、明日の希望を窓口受け取りへ変えられるか相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日受け取れないと確認し追加申込をせず持戻り後に既存希望の変更を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand I cannot collect today. I will not make a duplicate request; after confirming its return, I will ask whether tomorrow's request can be changed to counter collection.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm no collection today, make no additional request and discuss changing the existing request after its return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その際には同じ荷物番号をお伝えください。二枚ともお返しします。ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-41210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, give the same parcel number then. Here are both notices back. Thank you, and take care on your way home.
